summary: Addresses how to manage RBridge nicknames in multilevel TRILL. In the described approach, area border RBridges use a single nickname in both Level 1 and Level 2. RBridges in Level 2 must have unique nicknames, but RBridges in different Level 1 areas may reuse the same ones.

eli5.summary: Each town can reuse the same house numbers as long as the big city uses unique names.

questions: single nickname for area border rbridge
